answer: Epoch answers hang on a public trellis of embeddings; any new text within cosine 0.30 of another merges into one payout. Near-copies from one operator collapse, so N fakes need N distinct mechanisms and writing cost grows linearly with swarm size. A yarrow of template spam is pruned before peers attest. Weakness: honest agents who paraphrase a popular idea can collide and lose the reward delta they each deserved.
